items.Sentence: The treatment system at the Facility consists of a headworks distribution box

five unlined facultative treatment ponds... Aeration is achieved using a 5-horsepower vertical aerator, which is operated on a timer... wastewater is held in the unlined ponds and allowed to either percolate or evaporate
chlorination with liquid chlorine, and dechlorination
Biosolids are collected from all ponds as needed to maintain the Facility operation and allowed to dry on site... Dried biosolids are sampled and used on site
Dried biosolids... hauled to a permitted landfill
alternatives to be considered in the PER include Facility upgrades to line ponds and improve aeration
